items.title: The Prayer Verse No One Mentions
items.description: Why do some prayers go unanswered? The Bible gives several reasons that are rarely talked about. In this study, we examine Scripture in context to see what God says can hinder prayer, and why one overlooked verse may change the way you think about your relationship with God.

items.title: Does God Care If You’re Right?
items.description: Consider how believers handle disagreements.

items.title: Spiritual Burnout
items.description: What causes even the most dedicated, zealous believers to reach a point where they simply have nothing left to give? In "Spiritual Burnout," Rick Shabi examines the subtle progression of this spiritual condition by using the biblical account of Elijah to reveal why human effort eventually fails and how God restores the weary disciple.

items.title: A Gospel of Repentance
items.description: Why is repentance the primary gospel message proclaimed throughout the New Testament, and why does God require far more than simply saying "I'm sorry"? In this sermon, Rick Shabi shows how Jesus Christ and the Apostles made repentance the non-negotiable core of the gospel—demonstrating why turning to God isn't a one-time ritual or an annual checklist, but a

items.title: Why Some Prayers Go Unanswered: What the Bible Actually Says
items.description: Why does it sometimes feel like God isn’t answering our prayers? The Bible gives several reasons prayer can be hindered, delayed, or left unanswered, and some of them are rarely talked about. In this study, we’ll look at what Scripture says about prayer, obedience, faith, motives, relationships, patience, and our walk with God. Rather than assuming every una
items.author: Colton Hadley (Bible Daze)

items.title: The Simplicity That is in Christ
items.description: Why does human nature naturally complicate, resist, and dilute the clear commands of God? In this sermon, Rick Shabi explores 2 Corinthians 11:3, examining how subtle human reasoning, worldly philosophies, and self-justification pull believers away from pure, single-minded devotion to Jesus Christ.
items.author: Rick Shabi

items.title: Truthing in Love
items.description: What does it truly mean to "speak the truth in love," and why is biblical truth meant to be an active verb rather than mere head knowledge? In "Truthing" in Love , Rick Shabi explores Ephesians 4:15, revealing that the true Church of God is fundamentally marked by both actively living the truth and practicing selfless agape love.

items.title: Biblical Accountability - The Vanishing Trait l Rick Shabi
items.description: In a culture dominated by finger-pointing, legal spin, and shifting blame, personal responsibility seems to be fading away. In "Biblical Accountability — The Vanishing Trait," Rick Shabi examines why accountability is essential for every believer and what God expects of His Church.

items.title: What Is Agape Love?
items.description: What is the true biblical definition of agape love, and why can it only be defined by Jesus Christ? In "What Is Agape Love?", Rick Shabi contrasts human definitions of love with the divine, self-sacrificing agape required of God's true disciples.

items.title: Are You Living By Every Word? (Carefully, Diligently, Willingly, Now) | Rick Shabi
items.description: What does it truly mean to live "by every word that proceeds from the mouth of God"? In "Are You Living By Every Word?", Rick Shabi explores the specific adverbs and qualifiers God uses throughout Scripture—challenging believers to examine whether they are obeying God carefully, diligently, willingly, and with end-time urgency.

items.title: The Danger of Politics
items.description: How do global power struggles, corporate games, and internal factionalism threaten true spiritual unity? In "The Danger of Politics," Rick Shabi exposes the destructive nature of political maneuvering, flattery, and self-serving ambition—both in the world and within the Church of God.

items.title: The Deceptive Heart | Rick Shabi
items.description: How well do we truly know the motives lurking within our own minds? In "The Deceptive Heart," Rick Shabi explores Jeremiah 17:9 and Romans 8:7, unpacking the subtle ways natural human reasoning can deceive us and why true spiritual growth requires honest, ongoing self-examination before God.
items.author: Rick Shabi

items.title: Hope or Expectation
items.description: Is your faith built on vague wishful thinking or absolute divine certainty? In "Hope or Expectation," Rick Shabi unpacks the profound biblical difference between human "hope" and the confident, unshakable "expectation" God requires of His called children.

items.title: The Sign of The Cut: Is the Sabbath Optional?
items.description: Discover why the Sabbath isn't a mere tradition, but a perpetual sign of God's covenant. By examining the biblical concept of kareth (divine severance) across both the Old and New Testaments, this study explores how honoring the Fourth Commandment demonstrates covenant loyalty and divine mercy.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: Did Paul Really Teach That God’s Law Ended?
items.description: Did Paul really teach that God's law came to an end? Passages from Romans and Galatians are often cited to support that claim, but are they being read in context?
items.author: Colton Hadley (Bible Daze)

items.title: Did Jesus Teach Eternal Hell... or Something Else?
items.description: Examining biblical language about the afterlife.

items.title: No One Goes to Heaven When They Die? (Sheol Explained)
items.description: A study of Sheol.

items.title: Heaven, Hell… But Purgatory?
items.description: Examining purgatory.

Where Hope Begins
items.description: In a rapidly shifting world of economic instability, moral breakdown, and increasing global control, where do we turn for genuine security? In "Where Hope Begins," Rick Shabi exposes the futility of trusting in human systems and points to the only unshakable anchor—Jesus Christ and the Kingdom of God.

items.title: How to Define “Walking in the Spirit
items.description: Is walking in the Spirit a feeling or a lifestyle? Discover the "Battle of the Nature" between the carnal mind and the Spirit of God. Learn why the Holy Spirit wasn't given to replace the Law, but to provide the power to finally obey it.
items.author: Colton Hadley (Bible Daze)

items.title: GOD’S BIBLICAL FEAST DAYS (An introduction)
items.description: Are the Biblical Holy Days "abolished" traditions or eternal statutes? Explore the Hebrew meaning of olam and discover why the Holy Days (Feasts) of the LORD remain the master blueprint for God’s plan of salvation in both the Old and New Testaments
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: THE SABBATH
items.description: Why do over 30 languages across the globe still call Saturday "the Sabbath"? Explore the creation-based origins of the seventh-day rest and discover why there is no scriptural mandate for the historical shift to Sunday worship.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: THE PASSOVER
items.description: Is Passover just a historical tradition, or is it the key to understanding your salvation? Discover why Jesus didn't abolish this Feast, but redefined it as a perpetual memorial of His sacrifice.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: Saturday Sabbath vs. Sunday Sacredness
items.description: Why did the Sabbath move from Saturday to Sunday? Discover the "bad seed" of Laodicea and the 4th-century council that officially outlawed the biblical Sabbath. Learn why the Catholic Church admits this was an act of human authority—and why the Reformation never changed it back.
items.author: Colton Hadley (Bible Daze)

items.title: The FEAST OF UNLEAVENED BREAD
items.description: Redemption is just the beginning. Discover why the seven-day Feast of Unleavened Bread is the "Bread of Sincerity" for every believer. Learn how the physical act of removing leaven mirrors the spiritual transformation of leaving "Egypt" behind to walk in the purity of Christ.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: THE WAVE SHEAF OFFERING
items.description: What happened between the empty tomb and the Upper Room? Discover the "Wave Sheaf Offering"—the prophetic moment Jesus Christ ascended to the Father as the first of the spiritual harvest.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: THE FEAST OF WEEKS - PENTECOST
items.description: From the fire of Sinai to the tongues of Acts 2, Pentecost is the day God writes His Law on the human heart. Discover the "50-day count" from the empty tomb and why the "Firstfruits" of the wheat harvest represent the empowerment of every believer today.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: TEXTURAL CRITICISM OF THE BIBLE (PART 1)
items.description: How do we know the Bible we read today is what was actually written? Explore the staggering manuscript evidence that makes the Bible the most historically reliable document of the ancient world.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: THE FEAST OF TRUMPETS
items.description: The sound of the Shofar is more than a call to worship—it’s a warning. Discover why the Feast of Trumpets is the prophetic key to the Second Coming and the "Last Trumpet."
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: THE DAY OF ATONEMENT
items.description: Forgiveness is only half the story—sin must also be removed. Discover the mystery of the "Azazel Goat" and why the Day of Atonement is the prophetic blueprint for the binding of Satan and the total reconciliation of humanity to God.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: THE FEAST OF TABERNACLES
items.description: Why did Jesus Christ "pitch His tent" among us? Discover the joy of the Feast of Tabernacles—the seven-day celebration of God’s dwelling with man.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: THE EVIDENCE OF JESUS OUTSIDE THE BIBLE (PART 2)
items.description: What did the enemies of the early Church say about Jesus? Explore the "hostile witnesses" of history—from Roman governors to Greek satirists—who confirmed the life, crucifixion, and worship of Jesus Christ long before the New Testament was finalized.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: THE EVIDENCE OF JESUS OUTSIDE THROUGH THE DARKENING OF THE SUN (PART 3)
items.description: History and science agree: the darkness at the crucifixion was no ordinary eclipse. Discover the ancient Roman archives and non-Biblical historians that corroborate the supernatural "portent" recorded in the Gospels.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: WHEN WAS THE FIRST NEW TESTAMENT WRITTEN? AND BY WHOM? (PART 4)
items.description: How soon after the crucifixion did the first reports of the Resurrection appear? While most ancient biographies were written centuries after their subjects died, the "creeds" of the New Testament circulated within months.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: THE HISTORICAL RELIABILITY OF THE NEW TESTAMENT AND GOSPELS (PART 5)
items.description: Why would a people waiting for a conquering King invent a story about a crucified criminal? Discover why the "improbability" of a dying Messiah is one of the strongest proofs that the New Testament accounts are true. It’s a message that defied every Jewish expectation of the time.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: PROVING THE ACCURACY AND RELIABILITY OF THE BIBLE THROUGH PROPHECY (PART 6)
items.description: What are the odds of one man fulfilling 332 specific prophecies written centuries before His birth? Explore the staggering mathematics of Messianic prophecy. From the "Texas Silver Dollar" analogy to the incomprehensible 1 in $10^{157}$ probability, discover why the life of Jesus Christ is the ultimate proof of the Bible's divine authorship.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: PROOF OF THE BIBLE THROUGH THE CRUCIFIXION AND RESURRECTION OF JESUS CHRIST (PART 7)
items.description: Is the Resurrection a matter of blind faith or historical fact? Explore the overwhelming evidence for the death and rising of Jesus Christ. From the admission of skeptical scholars to the forensic failure of "stolen body" theories, discover why the empty tomb remains the most secure fact of ancient history.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: A NEW BEGINNING - WHAT DOES JESUS’ CRUCIFIXION AND RESURRECTION MEAN FOR US? (PART 8)
items.description: Does the meaning of life come down to a single historical question? Discover the six factual pillars of the life of Jesus, from the empty tomb to the martyrdom of the Apostles. Explore why world-class scholars and Oxford philosophers calculate a 97% probability of the resurrection—and what that truth means for your purpose today.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: PART I: THE BEGINNING: THE ORIGINS OF BAPTISM
items.description: Why did the Pharisees recognize baptism before it was ever explained in the New Testament? Discover the "missing" history of this sacred rite and why Jesus Christ’s immersion was a monumental turning point in God’s plan for humanity.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: PART II: THE WASHING AWAY OF SIN
items.description: Before there was "Baptism," there was the ritual washing of the Hebrews. Discover why God commanded three-day cleansings at Sinai and how the ancient Israelites understood the link between physical water and spiritual purity long before the New Testament was written.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: PART III: MIKVEH - A NEW MEANING
items.description: How can a word for "a collection of water" also mean "hope"? Explore the fascinating Hebrew word mikveh and discover how its transformation from Genesis to Jeremiah reveals the true purpose of baptism and our relationship with the Hope of Israel.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: PART IV: THE INTERTESTAMENTAL PERIOD - THE SILENT YEARS
items.description: Between the prophets and the Gospels lie 400 years of silence—but the archaeology speaks volumes. Discover why hundreds of ritual immersion pools began appearing across Israel just before Jesus arrived, and how the "Mikveh" became the physical precursor to Christian baptism.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: PART V: THE HOPE IN JESUS CHRIST’s HEALINGS
items.description: Were Jesus Christ’s miracles at the Pools of Bethesda and Siloam a coincidence? Archaeology reveals these were actually ancient Mikveh pools. Discover how Jesus used these "collections of water" to prove He was the living fulfillment of Jeremiah’s prophecy: the true Hope of Israel.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: PART VI: DID JESUS JUST TURN WATER INTO WINE?
items.description: Was the miracle at Cana more than just a wedding gift? Discover why the "six stone water jars" were actually instruments of ritual purification and how Christ turning water into wine signaled the end of temporary rituals and the birth of an everlasting covenant.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: PART VII: THE CONCLUSION – THE HOPE WE HAVE IN WHAT WAS PROMISED TO US
items.description: Why is Jesus called the "Living Hope"? Beyond the ritual of the Mikveh lies a promise made before time began. Discover how the "imperfect" waterpots of the Old Covenant were filled by Christ to bring life and immortality to light through the Gospel.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: THE EIGHTH DAY
items.description: What happens after the Millennium? Discover "The Eighth Day"—the final step in God’s plan that offers every human being who ever lived a fair and just opportunity for salvation. Explore the mystery of the Great White Throne Judgment and the moment death itself is defeated forever.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: End Time Readiness - Loving the Truth amf Spiritual Discernment (Final Sermon)
items.description: How can believers remain standing in an age of widespread deception, cultural confusion, and rapid global shift? In this final sermon of Rick Shabi's physical life, he examines what it takes to be truly ready for the return of Jesus Christ—highlighting the vital necessity of loving the truth and developing spiritual discernment.

items.title: The Way - Why Biblical Knowledge Isn't Enough
items.description: What does it take to go beyond memorizing Scripture and actually live the way of Jesus Christ? In "The Way — Why Biblical Knowledge Isn't Enough," Rick Shabi explores why having vast Bible knowledge is meaningless if it doesn't transform our daily lives, character, and obedience before God.

items.title: Spiritual Cancer
items.description: How does hidden sin, false doctrine, or an unaddressed attitude quietly destroy a believer's spiritual life? In "Spiritual Cancer," Rick Shabi uses the sobering physical reality of cancer to illustrate how unrepented sin and compromise metastasize within the human heart and the Church if left unchecked.

items.title: THE ANISOTROPIC GEMSTONES OF REVELATION 21
items.description: Why are diamonds—the world's most famous "precious" stone—missing from the New Jerusalem? Discover the startling optical physics hidden in Revelation 21 and why every single gemstone in the city's foundation shares a rare property that creates a "rainbow" of light.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: THE HEAVENS STRETCHED ABOVE THE EARTH
items.description: Did the Bible predict the expanding universe? While the Big Bang theory faces new challenges from the James Webb Telescope, the ancient Hebrew word "natah" reveals a universe that is both "stretched out" and continuously sustained. Explore the startling connection between cosmic dust and the "canopy" of Isaiah.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: THE POLAR ICE CAPS AND THE FROZEN REALM
items.description: How did an ancient writer in the Middle East describe miles-deep ice and frozen oceans? While the North Pole wasn't "discovered" until the 1900s, the Book of Job accurately detailed the "frozen deep" millennia ago. Discover the polar evidence hidden in the Bible's oldest book.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: THE FRAGILE EARTH (SOIL EROSION)
items.description: Who "discovered" soil erosion? While modern geology credits 18th-century thinkers, the Book of Job described the "wearing away of stones" millennia ago.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: NOAH’S ARK: THE ENGINEERING MARVEL THAT SURVIVED THE FLOOD
items.description: How did an ancient man with no shipbuilding experience design a vessel that outperforms modern cargo ships? Discover the "perfect proportions" of Noah’s Ark and why the dimensions given in Genesis 6 perfectly align with the physics of buoyancy discovered centuries later.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: THE CREATOR’S VANTAGE POINT
items.description: Who "discovered" that the Earth was round? While history books credit Pythagoras, the Bible recorded the "circle of the Earth" centuries earlier.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: HANGING IN THE VOID
items.description: Elephants, turtles, or empty space? While ancient mythologies claimed the Earth was held up by physical giants or beasts, the Book of Job declared it "hangs on nothing" millennia before modern science.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: THE SOLAR ECLIPSE
items.description: Is the solar eclipse a "cosmic coincidence" or a divine signal? Explore the "perfect ratio" that makes Earth the only known planet to witness a total eclipse and why ancient civilizations—and the Bible—viewed the darkening sun as a sobering warning.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: ALL THINGS CREATED
items.description: Is the universe a cosmic accident or a masterpiece of engineering? Explore the "fine-tuning" of the four fundamental forces—from gravity to nuclear strength—and discover why the mathematical precision of our world points directly to a Divine Architect.
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: SCIENCE AND SCIENTISTS
items.description: Does the Bible contradict science, or does it actually provide the foundation for it? Explore the history of scientific thought—from Aristotle to Einstein—and discover why the consistent laws of physics point toward a Creator who established them "by Him and for Him."
items.author: Patrick Shabi

items.title: Our Collective Part in Advancing the Mission
items.description: How does individual obedience impact the collective mission of God's Church? In "Our Collective Part in Advancing the Mission," Rick Shabi explores the vital role every believer plays in fulfilling the Great Commission, maintaining unity, and eliminating hidden compromise.

items.title: Spiritual Lessons from the Winter Season
items.description: What is God doing during the quiet, barren seasons of life? In "Spiritual Lessons from the Winter Season," Rick Shabi explores the divine purpose behind the cold, dark months between the Holy Days, showing how believers can use this crucial window to examine their spiritual walk and prepare for new growth.

items.title: Standing in the Gap
items.description: What does it mean to stand in the gap when truth fails and society crumbles around us? In "Standing in the Gap," Rick Shabi explores Ezekiel 22:30, delivering a powerful challenge for believers to build strong spiritual walls and stand unyielding for God's truth in perilous times.

items.title: Beauty for Ashes
items.description: What does it take to turn a world of ashes into a virtual paradise? In this message, Rick Shabi explores the prophetic transformation of the world during the Millennium, drawing from Isaiah 61 and Ezekiel to reveal the raw process of God's restoration.

items.title: Living Stones
items.description: From time to time, we need to be reminded of the great calling, and purpose God has given us—to remember what He is doing and what we are called to do. In this inspiring message, Rick Shabi examines what it truly means to be a "living stone" built into the spiritual temple of God.

items.title: Don't Drift Away: The Silent Danger in Every Christian’s Life
items.description: How does a believer gradually lose their spiritual edge without even realizing it? In "Don't Drift Away," Rick Shabi unpacks the urgent warning of Hebrews 2:1, exposing the subtle, silent compromises that pull Christians away from God and their high calling.

items.title: I See Men Like Trees Walking: Why Jesus Healed the Blind Man Twice
items.description: Why did Jesus heal the blind man at Bethsaida in two separate stages? In "I See Men Like Trees Walking," Rick Shabi unpacks this unique miracle to reveal how God compares human spiritual growth and character to the resilience, purity, and fruitfulness of trees.
